p: hundreds: According to their bands, or ensigns.
or these years: Meaning, a long time, that is, four months and certain days, 1Sa 27:7.
heads of these men: Would not Saul receive him to favour, if he would betray us?
going out and thy coming in: That is, was conversant with me.
not go fight against the enemies: This deception cannot be excused, for it grieved him to go against the people of God.
master's servants that are come with: With them that fled to thee from Saul.
